lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # VitaDeck

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: VitaDeck runs React-authored **Deck Apps** on a PlayStation Vita. A C host (raylib + QuickJS) renders an instance tree that a custom React reconciler drives; the same host builds for macOS/Linux for development. `@vitadeck/sdk` on npm is how Deck App authors build and package apps.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Prefer simple systems and small diffs. Fight scope creep; honor the dev's intent minimally. Leave the repo buildable after every change.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Glossary

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Read [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md) before naming anything user-facing or Shell-facing. It is the ubiquitous language (Deck App, Deck App Package, VitaDeck Shell, Runtime Upload, System Input, ...) and lists the words to avoid. `docs/adr/` holds the decisions behind the native layout; read the ones that touch your area and flag it loudly if your change contradicts one.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: When this file speaks:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `you` is the agent reading this file and changing VitaDeck.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `author` is a developer building a Deck App with the SDK, outside this repo.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `host` is the desktop build of the native app; `Vita` is the device build.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## How it works

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: `pnpm --dir js build` compiles the SDK, the example Deck Apps (`js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp`), and the runtime bundle (`js/dist/runtime/runtime.js`). CMake copies the runtime into the build tree on every build; the `stage_examples` target (also run by `run`) copies the examples into `<build>/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`, a plain `cmake --build out` does not. At startup `src/core/bootstrap.c` inits raylib, fonts, and the QuickJS runtime, loads the **Active Deck App** from the **Installed Deck App Library**, and the reconciler in `js/packages/runtime` mutates the native instance tree that `src/ui/render.c` paints each frame. `Start`/F1 toggles the **VitaDeck Shell**, which also hosts **Runtime Upload** (HTTP listener on 8787) for installing `.vdapp.zip` archives over LAN.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Where code lives

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/core/` - bootstrap, QuickJS runtime, event queue, package library and manifest parsing (vendored `vendor/jimp/jimp.h`, see ADR 0003)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `src/jslib/` - native functions exposed to JS: instances, timers, fetch, log, colors

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `src/ui/` - instance tree, rendering, fonts, images, input, scroll

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `src/shell/` - VitaDeck Shell; `src/upload/` - Runtime Upload listener; `src/platform/` - threads (POSIX vs Vita)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `js/packages/sdk/` - `@vitadeck/sdk`: author-facing components, theme, types, and the `vitadeck` CLI (`cli/`, scaffold under `cli/templates/`)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `js/packages/runtime/` - the React reconciler bundle the host embeds

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `js/examples/` - example Deck Apps; `smoke` is the CI smoke fixture

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `tests/` - CTest harnesses (`smoke_harness.c`, `package_manifest_harness.c`, `package_library_harness.c`, `timer_reload_harness.c`, `upload_parsing_harness.c`) and golden screenshots

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `vendor/quickjs` - git submodule; `docker-compose.yml` + `Dockerfile` - Vitasdk and Linux smoke images

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `.agents/skills/` - repo skills (`vitadeck-build`, `vitadeck-smoke`, `vitadeck-manual-testing`, `vitadeck-vdapp-upload`, `vitadeck-deck-app-init`) plus `comprehende` installed from `matemolnar8/comprehende` via the `skills` CLI (`skills-lock.json`) and `pages`, a repo-owned skill with its own publish script. `.claude/skills` symlinks here. Published via `npx skills add matemolnar8/vitadeck`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Setup

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Node.js 22+ and pnpm. `pnpm --dir js install` once.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `git submodule update --init --recursive` if `vendor/quickjs/quickjs.c` is missing.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Host build needs CMake, raylib 5.5, curl, OpenSSL, zlib (`brew install raylib` on macOS; raylib + OpenGL/X11 dev packages on Linux). On Linux/GCC configure with `CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -S . -B out -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group"`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Vita build and Linux smoke run in Docker. Start Docker Desktop first.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The first CMake configure downloads the pinned runtime fonts and Twemoji images ([cmake/fonts.cmake](cmake/fonts.cmake), [cmake/twemoji.cmake](cmake/twemoji.cmake)) into the gitignored `assets/fonts/` and `assets/emoji/`; offline it warns, builds anyway with fallbacks (raylib's built-in font, missing-glyph boxes for CJK, a fallback glyph for emoji), and the next configure retries.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Uploading a Vita build (`upload_vita`, `upload_vpk`, `run`) reads the Vita's IP from `PSVITAIP` when CMake configures, e.g. `export PSVITAIP=192.168.1.177`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Releases: [docs/releasing.md](docs/releasing.md).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Footguns

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 1. **Stale `js/dist`.** Native CMake copies `js/dist/runtime` into the build tree. After any change under `js/`, run `pnpm --dir js build` before rebuilding or running the host, or you will debug yesterday's JS.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. **Two-language package format.** The Deck App Package Manifest is validated natively in `src/core/package_manifest.c` and produced by the SDK CLI. A change to one without the other ships packages the host rejects, or accepts packages the SDK never emits. Update both and the `package_manifest` CTest harness.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 3. **Platform goldens.** `tests/fixtures/smoke_golden.Linux.png` is the only canonical golden (ADR 0002). Refresh it only with `scripts/smoke-docker.sh update-golden`, never from a macOS run. Do not re-enable `smoke_harness` in the macOS ctest step.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 4. **Secrets in examples.** `js/examples/chat/src/genesys/genesys.local.ts` is gitignored and holds real credentials. Never commit it, never paste its contents, and never "fix" imports by renaming it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 5. **Running from the wrong cwd.** The host resolves `vitadeck-data/` relative to the working directory (or `VITADECK_DATA_ROOT`). Run `./vitadeck` from `out/`, not the repo root.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Hit every surface

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The common defect is a change that works on the host and breaks the Vita, or works in one example and breaks the SDK contract.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Targets.** Host (macOS/Linux) and Vita share `src/`. Anything touching threads, filesystem, networking, or GL belongs behind `src/platform/` or needs a Vita Docker build to prove it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Author contract.** `@vitadeck/sdk` is published. A change to its exports, types, CLI flags, scaffold template, or manifest shape is a breaking change for authors. Bump the Deck App Package Schema Version when the manifest shape changes.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Inputs.** Vita buttons and host keyboard mappings (F1 Start, Enter confirm, Backspace back) must stay in sync in `src/ui/input.c` and in `CONTEXT.md`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Reverse states.** Upload needs cancel, install needs removal, Shell open needs Shell close. Check the failure paint, not just success.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Docs.** If a change makes `CONTEXT.md`, an ADR, the SDK README, or a skill inaccurate, fix it in place. Do not append a second account.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Verifying

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Use `scripts/agent-check.sh` from the repo root; pick the smallest tier that proves the change:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `fast` - JS typecheck, SDK CLI tests, JS lint, JS and C format checks. Run after every change.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `host` - JS build, host build, non-smoke CTest. Run for any `src/` or runtime change.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `smoke` - Dockerized Linux visual smoke. Run when rendering, theme, fonts, or Deck App output change.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `full` - all of the above plus the Vita Docker build. Run before a PR that touches native code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Individual commands: `pnpm --dir js tsc`, `pnpm --dir js test:cli`, `pnpm --dir js lint`, `pnpm --dir js format:check`, `pnpm --dir js build`, `./scripts/clang-format.sh check` (or `format` to apply), `cmake -S . -B out && cmake --build out`, Vita: `docker-compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - C under `src/` follows `.clang-format`; run `cmake -S . -B out` so `out/compile_commands.json` exists for clangd.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Write React for the React Compiler: pure renders, Rules of Hooks, accurate effect deps, no manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`/`memo`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - For a UI change, do one pass in the real host window (load the `vitadeck-manual-testing` skill). Ask before testing on Vita hardware; it is Máté's device.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Pull requests

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Open a PR only when asked, or when requested feature work is ready under an approved plan.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Conventional titles, plain language: `fix(shell): upload screen shows bind failure`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Body: the problem in a sentence or two, then how you fixed it, then which agent-check tier passed. End with the model and harness that did the work.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Review the diff with the `comprehende` skill (base is the merge-base with `main`, head is the branch tip), `export` it, then host the export with the `pages` skill using `--pr <number>`. Put the printed URL in the PR body. When the PR gets new commits, refresh the review and publish again to the same URL.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - UI changes need before/after screenshots or an updated golden. Upload evidence to GitHub; do not commit PR-only images.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - One request is one PR.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Documentation

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Most code changes do not need a docs change. Agents can read the code.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `README.md` and `js/packages/sdk/README.md` are for authors. Change them when a CLI command, install step, or author-visible behavior changes.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `CONTEXT.md` is the glossary. Add a term only when a new user-facing concept appears; keep the "Avoid" lines current.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `docs/adr/` is for decisions and their reasons. One file per decision, rewrite when it changes, never append a second account.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Do not enumerate fields, narrate control flow, or keep file catalogs. Link to source instead.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Plans and work artifacts

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Do not commit plans, research notes, or scratch files. Keep them outside the worktree.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - GitHub Issues on `matemolnar8/vitadeck` are the tracker; use `gh`. A merged PR is the implementation record.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Notes from Máté

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: I want simple C and simple TypeScript solving a real problem: React on a PS Vita. The host is a thin, honest rendering of the instance tree, and the SDK is the only public surface. Keep platform quirks behind `src/platform/`, keep the manifest contract explicit, and prefer deleting machinery over adding it.
